releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.212: Update Check refresh now restores the Diary Me menu after the verified web bundle reload. Existing APK download/install and web update verification flows are unchanged. Includes Web Update 383. Existing notes, photos, PINs, locks, widgets, and saved data are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: Web Update 385: Moved the copyable Update Report popup into the exact Me-button dropdown area. It now opens inside the Me menu instead of appearing as a separate centered screen overlay. Copy, × close, and the existing native updater/download/install flow remain unchanged.
